trained_on: MDVR-KCL read text (English, smartphone), 5 s windows
cross_dataset_headline: MDVR-KCL to Italian read text without young controls, random_forest, raw features: window AUROC 0.749 (95% CI 0.622-0.843), speaker-level 0.749, 46 speakers. The Italian recordings are confounded (see docs/data_card.md), so this is not evidence the model recognises Parkinson's.
limits: NeuroVoice is a screening-support research prototype. It is not a diagnosis. The model was trained on English speech from 37 people in one dataset, has not been tested on other languages, microphones or rooms, and has no clinical validation. Please talk to a doctor about any concerns.

band_precision.note: in_sample is what the cut was tuned on and is optimistic; crossfit picks the cut on other speakers and is the number to quote.

selection_note: Best of 3 models on the same CV, so its score is slightly optimistic; all three are in results/train_cv.csv.
